title: AuditMaintenanceResult
description: Result of `deadlatch audit verify` or `deadlatch audit repair --quarantine`. CLI JSON stdout must match this document. Issues list at most 100 entries (line_number + reason_code + optional segment_name basename only). Never includes raw log lines, credentials, account data, or absolute paths. Repair success additionally reports quarantine_name (basename only), quarantine_sha256, and source_sha256. Optional collection summaries (segments_scanned, legacy_records, chained_records, chain_start, chain_head) are backward-compatible extensions. Hash-chain issues use record_hash_mismatch / prev_hash_mismatch / duplicate_record_id / schema_version_downgrade. Repair that detects chain integrity problems returns status=invalid, writes nothing, and refuses automatic relink. v1 records are legal only in the legacy baseline file and only before any v2 record; a v1 line in a UTC day shard or after v2 is schema_version_downgrade.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this result document.

operation.description: Which audit-maintenance command produced this result.

status.description: clean = no invalid lines (verify or repair no-op); invalid = verify found damage, or repair refused to relink a chain integrity problem; repaired = quarantine wrote at least one line; error = path/lock/IO failure.

valid_lines.description: Count of schema-valid audit records in the scanned snapshot.

invalid_lines.description: Count of damaged or chain-invalid lines.

issues.description: Prefix of discovered problems, at most 100. Blank lines are not issues. segment_name is a basename only.

segment_name.description: Basename of the legacy file or UTC shard. Never an absolute path.

issues_truncated.description: true when invalid_lines exceeds the 100-issue echo cap.

quarantine_name.description: Basename of the unique quarantine JSON file. Present only when repair isolated at least one line.

quarantine_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the quarantine file bytes. Present only on successful repair.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the repaired segment bytes before repair. Present on successful repair; optional on verify.

segments_scanned.description: Number of legacy + shard files scanned.

legacy_records.description: Count of schema-valid v1 records (unchained history).

chained_records.description: Count of schema-valid v2 records in the local hash chain.

chain_start.description: record_hash of the first visible v2 record, or null when none exist.

chain_head.description: record_hash of the last visible v2 record, or null when none exist.
